notes.title: XLarn Guide/Wiki released
notes.content:
[p]We are pleased to announce that our guide/wiki page is finally ready for launch even though some parts might not be completely finished yet.[/p][p]You can access it on our site: [url="https://swinfjord-games.com/wiki"]swinfjord-games.com/wiki[/url][/p][p]With this guide it will be easier for new players and also experienced larn players to fight through the dangerous and sometimes really confusing Caverns of Larn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8433075/bb34f53733990f5c38c63a375b84ea5c91f99940.png"][/img][/p][p]As stated on the guide/wiki page all this information can gladly be used for your own guides in any form[/p][p]
While looking for the information in this guide we noticed some serious balancing problems, which we will take on next. The next goal will be a re-balancing patch for XLarn to guarantee the fun of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you can use this guide to your advantage.[/p][p][/p][p]We are looking forward to your feedback about this guide.[/p][p]If you notice anything wrong or unclear, please let us know as always via e-mail: [url="https://wizard@swinfjord-games.com"]wizard@swinfjord-games.com[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: XLarn 10th Anniversary, Version 23 & Mobile Version
notes.content:
Since the last release we have been hard at work to finally bring one of our earliest ideas for XLarn to fruition the [b]MOBILE VERSION[/b] for iOS and Android. You can read more about that and a short history of XLarns development and find the links on our website: https://swinfjord-games.com/posts/xlarn-version-23-ios-and-android-release/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8433075/66ec08f721b5d2a7300fa50c06da8c8d0e4afb83.png[/img]

From now on further updates will be released on all platforms at the same time.

We don't have a lot of new content for the Steam version this time except a few new achivements but we are working on modernizing the game further and rebalancing parts of it. Furthermore, we have been working on a wiki page for some time, which will also be published in the near future.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]

[*] Wealthy Man
[*] Hoarder
[*] Millionaire
[*] Billionaire
[*] Damn Bats!!!
[*] Strongest Rope
[*] Second chance

[/list]
[*] Minor Bug Fixes
[/list]

If you encounter any problems after updating please let us know via e-mail: wizard@swinfjord-games.com or on the Steam community discussion board so we can help you and fix the problems as soon as possible.
For any ideas or feedback you can also contact us.

We hope you enjoy the new version of the game!

notes.title: Update to Version 22.06
notes.content:
This is a smaller in-between Update adding some quality of life changes, new achievements and a lot of behind the curtain preparation for bigger things to come.

You can read all about the patchnotes on our website as well: [url=https://swinfjord-games.com/posts/xlarn-version-22-06/]XLarn Version 22.06[/url]

the update consists of the following gameplay changes and bug fixes:
[h2]gameplay changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] added new cave generation to make lava trap more of an obstacle
[*]     the spell window will now always show the current spells name
[*]     removed all cursor clipping for better usability
[*]     mirrors only reflected some spells for a while and would be destroyed by other spells now there will be a message about the mirror being destroyed instead of it just vanishing
[*]     the repeat action functionality of the number keys now has an overlay to show you the amount the next action will be repeated so accidents will not happen as often anymore
[*]     added number of known/unknown items to magic knowledge window to give it a bit more interaction value
[*]     added some new achievements
[list]
[*]         Anger a waterlord - Ocean Man
[*]         Anger a gnomeking - Royal rage
[*]         Get killed by your own projectile - Better be careful
[*]         Stop time forever - Permanent timeout
[*]         Anesthetize a vampire with garlic smell - Stinky stuff
[*]         Get the cross - Crusader
[*]         Make a vampire walk though a mirror - Come here little bat
[*]         Hide an item behind a statue - Is it gone now??
[*]         Fall down a bottomless pit - Still falling
[*]         Melt rings - Blacksmith
[*]         Drink the potion - Dad of the year
[*]         Learn every course in school - Bachelor of larn
[*]         Sell a jewel in the trade post - Not the best deal
[*]         Die from xrays - Radiant man
[*]         Kill 50 bats or rats - Pest control
[*]         Kill the God of Hellfire - Hellfire BBQ
[*]         Collect the hidden item from the statue - Phew, found it again
[/list]
[*]     casting permanence after timestop will now cause time to be stopped forever 
[/list]
[h2]bug fixes
[/h2]
[list]
[*]     fix “gewinner” button in german translation having duplicate hotkey
[*]     fix zoom and other special character hotkeys not working on macOS
[*]     added missing german translations for:
[list]
[*]         create, rename and delete player
[*]         enter password hint
[*]         wrong password alert
[*]         start game, fullscreen and window mode
[*]         attack, defense and common spells
[*]         “About XLarn”
[/list]
[*]     quickspell window will now be closed on players death
[*]     fixed a crash on 64bit systems
[*]     shot spells will now be properly cleaned on players death
[*]     the right side status window will now also properly reset on players death
[*]     monsters will now move before item requests pop up to prevent the illusion of a double move for monsters
[*]     fixed a bug where sometimes ring melting wouldn’t remove the molten ring
[/list]

If you encounter any problems after updating please let us know via e-mail: [b]wizard@swinfjord-games.com[/b] or on the steam community discussion board so we can help you and fix the problems as soon as possible. For any ideas or feedback you can also contact us.

ːEyeofLarnːWe hope you enjoy the new update!ːEyeofLarnː

notes.title: XLarn back in active development
notes.content:
[u][b][h2]:EyeofLarn:Welcome back to the caverns of Larn:EyeofLarn:[/h2][/b][/u]

XLarn is now back in active development and this update marks the first step to get into a more frequent release cycle.

the highlight of this update is the new mac version which supports newer versions of macOS as well as the newest generation of macs natively.

the update consists of the following gameplay changes and bug fixes:

[h3]gameplay changes[/h3]
- failed spells no longer count as in-game steps
- casting a spell now counts as an in-game step
- spells will now cost a spellpoint
- aborting a spell will no longer count as step
- added support for steam rich presence
- higher score multiplier
- game will now auto scroll from a 6 tile distance instead of 4 tiles

[h3]bug fixes[/h3]
- fixed numpad 5 press getting stuck in a wait action loop
- fixed zoom in and out command counting as in-game step
- fixed bug where spells will not use a spellpoint
- removed fullscreen button on ultrawide screens
- fixed focus change even on non valid input on player creation
- added UI hint on wrong user password
- reduced cpu usage on linux
- fixed crash on monster hit caused by floating damage number

If you encounter any problems after updating please let us know via e-mail: [b]wizard@swinfjord-games.com[/b] or on the steam community discussion board so we can help you and fix the problems as soon as possible.
For any ideas or feedback you can also contact us.

we hope you enjoy the new update!
:EyeofLarn:

notes.title: Update to version 22.01 the tooltip update
notes.content:
With the tooltip update the UI and the controls of XLarn get a rework. The tooltips make XLarn more accessible for newer players. For more expierienced adventurers: all aspects of XLarn can now be accessed with a keyboard without the need to grab your mouse in the middle of the game.

[h1]New Quickcast Window[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8433075/86911b17d70a0b76fc4522d67ad99886de46e53d.png[/img]
The new quickcast window on the bottom left of the game window allows players to assign known spells to F1-F8 and Shift + F1-F8 by pressing and holding.

[h1]Rebind Window[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8433075/39a5bb39f5bdd5247456e4104d5ae1992a5d638c.png[/img]
When you hold one of the F keys the rebind window will open and show all bindable spells.

[h1]Reworked Spell Window[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8433075/26497e30946d95da99037cefe96801be781a7812.png[/img]
The normal spell window now lists all spells as icons sorted by spell effect. Known spells are colored unknown spells are greyed out.

[h1]Tooltips[/h1][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8433075/4a9490d2d8503c7f662684abeb0cc7a4aca529f4.png[/img]
Tooltips everywhere.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
-Launcher window reworked for keyboard friendly controls
-New exit menu with old save function
-Exit button now in the top right corner
-Adjusted font size in Character sheet so no more scrolling is needed
-Fixed a bug with fire animation
-A few other bugfixes

[url=swinfjord-games.com/XLarnV2201.html]A short explanation of the UI changes.[/url]

Unfortunately we had to delay native steam controller support but we are aiming to get a public beta out in the next few weeks.
To see new stuff first follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/XLarnGame]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Update to version 21.04
notes.content:
This update mainly adresses game functionality on linux.

- added fullscreen option on linux
- fixed an issue with dual screen setups on linux
- fixed numpad enter key not working on linux
- added a score multiplier because the game got a lot harder after the last patch
- added coloring in the character sheet when stats are changing (stat turns red for a negative change and green for a positive one)
- added a few missing german translations
- fixed a bug where your strength won't be updated after a giant ant or centipede stung you
- fixed a bug where a broken ladder on a hole in the ceiling would cause the player to fall into a pit
- fixed a few issues with altars in the temple

Also we made a [b][url=https://twitter.com/XLarnGame]twitter account[/url][/b] to do stuff like community actions, giveaways and showing new features in development.

notes.title: Patch for Version 21.03
notes.content:
After the last update we stumbled upon a few really huge balancing problems so we decided to solve those first before we start working on a new updated version. This patch basically is a really big balancing patch.

-Completely reworked damage calculation in both directions
-Changed the different ways the game gets harder every difficulty
-Changed the strength of all weapons
-Changed the font size and placement in the character sheet so there's no need to grab your mouse to scroll
-A few bug fixes

notes.title: Update to Version 21.03
notes.content:
[h1]Version 21.03[/h1]
-Added linux and mac support
-Tax office is closed sometimes to make box identifying a bit harder
-College of larn has new courses and shows a text output with changed stats while visiting a course
-Altars in the temple now hold more valuable rewards than normal ones but also demand way more gold in return
-Big changes to balancing on higher difficulties

Fullscreen mode is currently not working correctly on linux so to prevent data loss it's disabled for now. We are working to fix this as soon as possible.
